assumption: The buffer size determined by GetMaximumChunkSize acts as an upper limit whose exceedance triggers the error kInvalidInputSize.
rationale: SWS_CRYPT_50042 explicitly defines GetMaximumChunkSize as the maximum buffer size for Update() calls in SignerPrivateCtx, whereas SWS_CRYPT_50039 provides kInvalidInputSize for unsupported data sizes.
